ocg_text: ① Activate only during the Damage Step when you have 3 or more Speed Counters. ② Select 1 Monster Card from your Deck and send it to the Cemetery. ③ Until the end of the Damage Step, the ATK of 1 monster on your field is increased by half the ATK of the sent monster. ④ You cannot draw a card on your next turn.

ja_kana: スリップ・ストリーム
ocg_text: ① Activate only when your Speed Counters are less than those of your opponent. ② During the Standby Phase of your next turn, increases your Speed Counters to a number equal to that of your opponent's counters.

ja_kana: デス・アクセル
ocg_text: ① Activate only when you suffer battle damage from an opponent's monster. ② Increases your Speed Counters by 1 for every 300 points of battle damage to your LP.

ja_kana: スピードスペル－スピード・ジャマー
ocg_text: ① Activate only when you have 2 or more Speed Counters. ② Removes 6 of your opponent's Speed Counters.

ja_kana: スピードスペル－アクセル・リミッター
ocg_text: ① During your opponent's next 2 turns, your opponent cannot place Speed Counters during their Standby Phases.

ja_kana: アサルト・コア
ocg_text: This card's name is treated as "Giant Battleship" while it is face-up on the field.
